events.label: French and Indian War ends
events.quote: The Treaty of Paris of 1763 ended the French and Indian War.

events.label: Stamp Act passed
events.quote: Parliament passed the Stamp Act on March 22, 1765.

events.label: Boston Massacre
events.quote: On March 5, 1770, British soldiers fired on a crowd in Boston.

events.label: Boston Tea Party
events.quote: On December 16, 1773, colonists destroyed East India Company tea.

events.label: First Continental Congress
events.quote: The First Continental Congress met in September 1774.

events.label: Lexington and Concord
events.quote: Fighting began at Lexington and Concord on April 19, 1775.

events.label: Declaration adopted
events.quote: Congress adopted the Declaration of Independence on July 4, 1776.

events.label: Siege of Yorktown ends
events.quote: Cornwallis surrendered at Yorktown on October 19, 1781.
